body:
Hi @jerboaa, if I understand it correctly there is nothing that the actual `quarkus-oidc-client-filter` can do, right ? 
FYI `quarkus-oidc-client` itself does not depend on REST client, `quarkus-oidc-client-filter` does, but it only implements `ContainerRequestFilter`. I wish I could just say - use `oidc-client-reactive-filter` :-)

> Hi @jerboaa, if I understand it correctly there is nothing that the actual `quarkus-oidc-client-filter` can do, right ?

That's right. It's just one of the integration tests which "reproduce" the failure. So does `main` and a couple of others.

body: CC @jamezp, Hi James, does it ring any bell, perhaps some relevant changes have been made  recently, thanks

Seems to be caused by `ManualClosingApacheHttpClient43Engine.createCleanable` becoming reachable, which in turn suggests that it's entering the else branche here?
https://github.com/resteasy/Resteasy/blob/main/resteasy-client/src/main/java/org/jboss/resteasy/client/jaxrs/engines/ManualClosingApacheHttpClient43Engine.java#L620..L630
Feel free to assign this to me, I've got a fix.
I did introduce using a `java.lang.ref.Cleaner` to remove the finalizer methods.

issue.title: Runtime init the cleaner instance in ResourceCleaner
issue.body:
Inject an accessor for the ResourceCleaner.CLEANER static variable so that the associated cleaner won't get initialized at build time and ends up being in the native image heap.

Closes: #31440
